phases.name: Final Mission Phase
phases.note: Phase 3 should remain a single climactic final mission.

campaignRules.locationControl: Alliance with most Battle Honours gained in that phase; tie-break with campaign total, then Warmaster decision.
campaignRules.ascendancy: Alliance with most Agenda Achieved cards; ties mean all tied alliances are in ascendancy.
campaignRules.relicAcquisition: At end of phases 1 and 2, each player draws as many alliance Relics as their Agenda Achieved count and keeps one.
campaignRules.discardAgendaAchieved: Discard previous phase Agenda Achieved cards after phase resolution.
campaignRules.defaultSchedule: 2 battles per player in Phase 1, 2 in Phase 2, 1 in Phase 3; Strike Force by default.
campaignRules.scheduleFlexibility: Warmaster may increase battles in phases 1 and 2 and vary army sizes. Phase 3 should remain one climactic final mission.
campaignRules.agendaSelection: If both players attempt Agendas, reveal Force Dispositions and consult the active Alliance Briefing matrix. If either declines, use Chapter Approved Primary Missions; only players who declined can score from that Primary.
campaignRules.agendaAchievedCardModel: There is one Agenda Achieved card identity per Alliance. Players can hold up to 3 at a time; each qualifying Agenda may award one or more copies/counters according to its conditions.

phase1.victor: Draw 1 random Battle Honour from Phase 1 deck

phase2.victor: Draw 1 random Battle Honour from Phase 2 deck

phaseRewards.agendaAchievedBonusDraw: A player who gained at least one Agenda Achieved card from that battle draws one additional card of the same type at the same time, chooses one of the drawn cards to keep, and returns the others to the relevant deck.

phase3.victor: Gains Path to Conquest; there is no ordinary Battle Honour/Skill draw for phase 3.

campaignRules.locationControlTieBreak: Compare total Battle Honours gained across the entire campaign; if still tied, Warmaster decides.
campaignRules.ascendancyTie: All Alliances tied for the highest Agenda Achieved count are in ascendancy.
campaignRules.relicDraws: At end of phases 1 and 2, each player draws from their own Alliance Relic deck a number equal to their Agenda Achieved cards, keeps one, and returns the rest to the deck.
campaignRules.phaseTransition: Discard all Agenda Achieved cards from the phase just resolved before proceeding.

implementationNotes: Use agendaDetails[].primaryMission.scoring as independently evaluated scoring entries; respect each timing and cumulative marker.
Objective Actions need persistent operation-marker state, per-turn use limits, eligible unit filters and completion timing.
Evaluate Agenda Achieved award groups separately: `any` means one listed condition is sufficient; separate groups can award additional cards.
Agenda Achieved cards are Alliance-specific identities tracked as quantities; max 3 held by a player at a time.
If a player declines an Agenda, only that player may score the Chapter Approved Primary Mission; the player attempting an Agenda scores only their Agenda Primary Mission.
Briefing chart selection must use the player's own Alliance Briefing and the ordered pair (own Force Disposition, opponent Force Disposition). The two players may receive different Agendas.
Until chart cell coordinates are machine-verified, provide a manual Agenda selector and Warmaster override; never infer a missing cell.
At end of phases 1 and 2, award victor Battle Honour and opponent Battle Skill; on a draw both receive Battle Skill. Apply the additional draw if the player earned an Agenda Achieved card.

At phase end, determine location control from that phase's Battle Honours; tie-break with total campaign Battle Honours, then Warmaster. Determine ascendancy from Agenda Achieved totals, with all tied Alliances in ascendancy.
Relic draws occur at end of phases 1 and 2 and use each player's Agenda Achieved count; keep one drawn Relic and return the others.
Campaign schedule defaults to 2/2/1 battles per player at Strike Force size; Warmaster may modify phases 1 and 2 but Phase 3 remains one climactic final mission.

upgradeRules.battleSkills: Awarded to the opponent of the battle victor in campaign phases 1 and 2; both players receive one on a draw.

relics.drawCount: Number of Agenda Achieved cards held by that player at the end of campaign phase 1 or 2.
relics.selection: Select one of the drawn relics to keep; return the others to the Alliance relic deck.

upgradeRules.agendaAchievedExtraDraw: If a player gains one or more Agenda Achieved cards from a battle, they draw one additional card of the same type at the same time, choose one card to keep, and return the others to the deck.
upgradeRules.phase3: The victor receives Path to Conquest; this is the only Phase 3 Battle Honour and determines control of the Phase 3 location.
